title: Metric handle-grasp and ring-seating relations
coverage_gap: This D_N contains five LL and five HH episodes, but no independently recombined nut_x and peg_goal_x. Absolute-coordinate correlations can substitute for the actual hand-to-handle and ring-to-peg errors. Extrapolation also creates larger lateral transport errors than the observed diagonal layouts.
reusable_regularity: Grasping is controlled by the handle relative to the hand; seating is controlled by the physical ring center relative to the peg goal, not the handle site relative to the peg. Expose both relations in world-aligned metric coordinates and at a fine contact scale, while retaining a coarse absolute robot position. The 45-channel deterministic representation includes an information-preserving core plus smooth distances, planar proximities and a regularized seating direction. Fixed physical scales rather than small support variances avoid artificially magnifying nearly constant channels. No controller, waypoint, action residual or time-based stage rule is used.
dependencies_preserved: World hand position and world axes retain workspace/robot kinematic dependence; vertical coordinates explicitly retain gravity and table/peg clearance dependence.
Handle minus hand, ring minus handle, and goal minus ring preserve the separate pickup and assembly constraints and the nonzero lever arm between handle and ring.
Native current and previous object wxyz quaternions, hand and handle increments, aperture and aperture change retain orientation, contact and recent motion information.

All non-absent raw fields can be reconstructed from the core features and fixed origin/scales; object2 channels are omitted only because task_materials declares them absent zeros. The visible peg is represented by goal_xyz; no additional obstacle or simulator channel is assumed.

One common DP; fixed action epsilon objective; causal two-observation conditioning

expected_failure_signature: Falsifiable: if geometry was the main confound, C should not collapse solely when nut and goal signs differ. Remaining failures should concentrate on premature lift, poor grasp contact, or lowering before planar ring alignment. E may still fail during long lateral transport because a fixed feature basis does not impose a compositional phase mechanism or directional action equivariance. This is a hypothesis, not measured performance.

required_runtime_fields.source: causal_context.raw_history [B,2,42] only; normalized history is intentionally replaced by a documented fixed-metric transform
required_runtime_fields.action_frame: Identity encode/decode: first three channels remain world_dx,world_dy,world_dz in native .01 m units; fourth is unchanged gripper. Only the host clips in the native action cube and executes four of sixteen steps.

support_fit_statistics: None. All configured scales are explicit physical design constants, not fitted on any other data. The host still fits its common raw normalizer on exact D_N.
architecture: One frozen common conditional 1D U-Net DP with condition_dim=45 and action_dim=4. No additional learned modules or auxiliary losses.
change_summary: Initial scientific design: deterministic multiscale relational representation, identity native actions. No performance feedback used; no structural repairs at creation.
